criteria.text: Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $3,000,000 (2 x ($8,600,000 - $6,500,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,600,000 is wrong.
Calculates the long-stop date as 29 July 2026 (150 days after signing on 1 March 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 12 September 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $3,000,000 and the Seller's $3,600,000.
Gives the long-stop period as 150 days and as the date 29 July 2026, with days remaining from 16 March 2026 (135 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
